label: evidence
about: Open-Meteo's hourly wind over the Lisbon area (close view) on 2026-11-12 (UTC), on a 0.25-degree lattice: at 10 m (speed, direction, gusts) and at 850 hPa (speed and direction, roughly 1,500 m up, where aircraft climb and descend). Evidence: a weather model's data as Open-Meteo serves it, not observations and not ours; for what was measured at the airports see crosswind.json (METAR). Hours from forecast_from on are Open-Meteo's forecast at the time read, replaced on the next run.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, https://open-meteo.com, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Its forecast API with past_days: the model's hourly analysis and short-range forecast, not observations.

grid.order: points row by row: for each lat (south to north), every lon (west to east); point k = lat[floor(k / lon.length)], lon[k % lon.length]

units.direction: degrees true the wind blows FROM (an arrow points to direction + 180)
